record.title: GGEN fanout current after R83 assimilation and R84 upstream return
record.body: CELL2 consumed Project2 state without rediscovery. R83 is assimilated on ggen-marketplace main@93c99170cad21e5914934837dbd01bb9e9f83d92. autofde-lab PR #88 exact head 1e34d1cfddbd90c86769f114e621584c0025bd55 passed R80 and PR CI and is assimilated at master@a004da26bdf2b0cd2bde434b365dade9916b2fe9. autofde PR #33 exact head adf9e840874bd0f3f2f0037b23b676ecf56c86f2 passed R80 and Self-Manufacturing Crown and is assimilated at main@d803547355f5fa0febda58abe4d14154b5d54e71. XaaS PR #32 exact head 6b87b222a9d9fad6c4802939562d35f5845b6812 passes R80; native CI fails because the BRCE admission correctly emits {:idempotency_conflict,key} but Reactor envelopes it as Reactor.Error.Invalid.RunStepError. Shared defect returned upstream once as R84 ash-reactor-domain-error-contract-pack, draft PR #324 exact head d958cd7f7b687a244fbd7a125df00737d5b04f65. No new consumer was guessed. No CONTROL commit counted as fanout.
